capabilities: duplicate canvas templates from a ribbon menu
define rules that match canvas cards by level-one title
apply default tags to duplicated canvases
disambiguation: Not a general note template tool like Templates; it only duplicates Canvas files.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README says tag-rule support is limited and more features are planned.
motivation: The author wanted an easy way to duplicate canvas templates and notes that generalizing tag rules to many workflows is challenging.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to duplicate a Canvas file as a reusable template with tags applied automatically.
summary: Visual tool that duplicates Canvas templates and can attach default tags to the copies via title-matching rules.
